items.issue: The narrated marriage, money, prior-marriage and suicide story concerns identifiable people and is presented without authenticated primary records.
items.disposition: Keep fully attributed and unverified; require court, financial and contemporaneous records plus responses before factual use.

items.issue: Provider/lover and dual-mating claims classify women as resource extractors or biologically compelled cheaters.
items.disposition: Do not generalize or use to diagnose an individual; preserve only as Mikey's framework.

items.issue: The bird paternity rate and evolutionary causal chain are unsourced and may be species, number or ASR errors.
items.disposition: Verify species, study and statistic before any factual citation; otherwise keep do_not_generalize.

items.issue: The video treats attraction as making later behavior automatically right and describes women as belonging to a man.
items.disposition: Do not convert into advice; attraction does not excuse harm or replace ongoing consent.

items.issue: Claims that feminism, media and capital deliberately impose appearance tyranny or engineer a pleasing economy lack sources and conflate many causal mechanisms.
items.disposition: Keep as rhetoric only; require demographic, media and market evidence for any factual use.

items.issue: The core three-misconception structure substantially overlaps mikey-gameshengjing-001 and parts of video-011, though the transcript is not reused.
items.disposition: Count as a distinct research source but give no extra confidence to repeated doctrine.

items.issue: ASR corrupts names, idioms, species terms and the closing quotation.
items.disposition: Use paraphrase only; listen to original audio before quoting exact wording or numbers.
